description: Maps keywords and file patterns to relevant skills for auto-activation

rules.message: This looks like a P2P data sync task. Consider using /add-p2p-sync for Hypercore replication patterns.

This involves P2P RPC. Consider using /p2p-rpc for Protomux request/response patterns.
This involves secure messaging. Consider using /secure-communication for encrypted Protomux channels.
